title: Japanese Udon Noodle Soup
description: A light and comforting Japanese-inspired noodle soup made with wholesome udon noodles. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a simmer in a large pot.
Add sliced shiitake mushrooms and cook for 3-4 minutes or until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add wholesome udon noodles to the pot and cook according to package instructions.
Stir in sesame oil, soy sauce, and sesame seeds.
Slice the ginger into thin rounds and add to the pot.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions.
